verdict.rationale: The docs describe built-in conversation analysis: custom success-evaluation criteria for goal achievement, sentiment analysis across completed conversations, structured data collection for outcomes, and conversation search. The platform also markets a dashboard to 'configure, deploy and monitor' agents. However, nothing explicitly shows these results aggregated into analytics dashboards with success rates or call-duration metrics. Duration appears only as a max-conversation-length setting. missing for 10: explicit evidence of an analytics dashboard with aggregated success rates and charts, call-duration metrics, outcome trend views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
